text: I got clear aligners here. The doctor is nice, and the service was good initially. I recommended several people to the clinic. However, lately, the scheduling system has become very problematic. Almost every time I have an appointment, I have to wait. I can understand a 5-10 minute wait, but I once had an appointment at 2:15 PM, and even arrived early, only to see the doctor around 3 PM – an hour's wait! I've seen other patients complain about this. Could the clinic please improve its scheduling? Also, I had clear aligners for 10 months, but it wasn't successful. I needed further corrections, which were free once, but it still wasn't right. So I decided to get another correction for an additional 5,000 baht because I wanted it to be perfect. Ultimately, it's still the same; my teeth aren't aligned. 😅 It took 1 year and 7 months. If I had used traditional metal braces, my teeth would probably be perfect. It's not that I didn't wear the clear aligners; I wore them for over 20 hours each. All my teeth are aligned beautifully, except for the crowded front teeth that worried me the most and led me to seek treatment. (If it was due to not wearing the aligners, wouldn't the other teeth not be aligned?) I regret the money spent. Finally, the doctor helped by grinding down the tooth. At the time, we didn't know that grinding the tooth down could help; otherwise, we might not have paid the extra 5,000 baht for the braces.
